summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FREA! arcade game with 5 new game modes (King of the Hill, Floor is Lava, Star Rush, Red Light Green Light, Freeze Tag), Party Mode meta-game system, and unified HUD across all modes. All features working correctly on desktop and mobile.
passed_tests: Lobby: Party Mode tile displays at top with full-width layout, 5 rounds indicator, game icons, and Setup button
Lobby: All 5 new mode tiles (koth, lava, stars, redlight, freeze) present with NEW badges
Lobby: All existing mode tiles (classic, race, survival, tag, hns, hoops, zen) still present
King of the Hill: Mode starts, shows intro with How-to-play card (3 steps), gameplay runs smoothly with glowing zone mechanic, HUD shows banner/timer/scoreboard
Floor is Lava: Mode starts, HUD elements visible, lava rising mechanic working
Star Rush: Mode starts, HUD elements visible, stars falling and collection working
Red Light Green Light: Mode starts, HUD elements visible, traffic light cycling working
Freeze Tag: Mode starts, HUD elements visible, IT/frozen mechanics working
Unified HUD: Mode banner shows at top-center (desktop) with icon, name, and goal text
Unified HUD: Timer and scoreboard visible in all modes
Unified HUD: How-to-play card appears on intro splash for all modes
Party Mode Setup: Modal opens when clicking START PARTY button
Party Mode Setup: All 11 mode toggles present (no zen), Select All/Clear buttons working
Party Mode Setup: Rounds options (3/5/8/12), Order options (shuffle/inorder), Rivals options (2/4/6/8) all present
Party Mode Setup: Start button disabled when <2 games selected
Party Mode Setup: Mode toggle functionality works (count updates when toggling)
Party Mode Run: Party starts with correct round count, mode rotation working
Party Mode Run: Banner shows 'Round X/Y' chip during gameplay
Party Mode Run: End screen shows party panel with standings, next-up card, NEXT ROUND button with countdown, END PARTY button
Party Mode Run: Rival roster maintained across rounds (same names/colors)
Party Mode Run: Normal Play Again/Lobby buttons hidden during party
Regression: All existing modes (classic, race, survival, tag, hns, hoops) start and play correctly with unified HUD
Mobile (390x844): Party Mode tile displays properly in full-width format
Mobile (390x844): Party Mode setup modal scrollable with 2-column grid layout
Mobile (390x844): Mode banner positioned at bottom-center, no overlap with emote FAB (bottom-left)
Mobile (390x844): All UI elements properly sized and positioned
